Root Discover is a pocket catalogue of apps, modules and tools for rooted Android devices: root managers (Magisk, KernelSU, APatch), LSPosed modules, ad blockers, debloaters, backup tools and more. Tap any entry to open its GitHub repository or homepage. Long-press to copy the link.\n\nThe Devices tab shows how open each phone brand is to bootloader unlocking, plus the device-specific projects that give temporary root on a locked bootloader.

Rooting and unlocking the bootloader can wipe your data, void your warranty, trip Samsung Knox permanently, break banking and payment apps, and in rare cases brick a device. Always back up first, read the guide for your exact model, and only install apps from sources you trust. Root Discover only lists links; it does not root your device.
App and device data come from Awesome Android Root (MIT License), maintained by its contributors. Root Discover is an independent viewer and is not affiliated with the projects it lists.
